mechanism: The Weyl group is generated by reflections in the root hyperplanes of the lattice. No extra physical scale is used.
assumptions: Roots are the norm-2 vectors of L_E8.

evidence.notes: Richard Borcherds, Root systems and reflection groups, section 18: root-hyperplane reflections generate the Weyl group. Applied to the E8 root system identified by the source node; mathematical provenance, not experimental verification.

confusion_guard: Deriving W(E8) from the lattice does not derive a frequency-mass embedding.
